newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria sells 3 floating interest T-bill issues.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria sells 3 floating interest T-bill issues.

text.p: Bulgaria's finance ministry on Monday sold three floating interest T-bill issues with maturities of three, nine and 12 months, yielding 20.66, 64.27 and 84.78 percent to maturity, the central bank said.
Bids were received for a total of 39.776 billion levs of T-bills but the ministry approved bids for 32.7 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par values or minimum acceptable prices set in advance.
Interest payment on the issues are due at maturity. It was set equal to the central bank main interest rate and is adjusted every time the rate changes.
The main interest rate is now set at 6.20 percent monthly or 74.40 percent annually.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 19,980 million levs 11,600.6 million levs
Average price of bids 93.84 pct 93.96 pct
Bids approved 13,980 million levs 10,550.6 million levs
Average yield to maturity 64.27 pct 84.78 pct
